verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs list JetBrains among the tools it works with, which is a first-party claim of a JetBrains integration. Nothing in the pack describes what that integration does, so interactive diffs or sharing selected code from inside a JetBrains IDE are unevidenced. The generic diff-inspection doc is about Cursor's own review flow, not JetBrains, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented interactive diff viewing inside JetBrains, documented sharing of selected code as context from JetBrains, plugin/setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
